doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 确保装备制造业平稳发展，加快结构调整，增强自主创新能力，提高自主化水平
quote_en: Ensure steady development of equipment manufacturing, speed up restructuring, strengthen innovation and raise localisation.
notes: Headline of a dedicated plan; broad concept spanning several L1s (nearest 机械设备) -> none; sub-sectors coded in separate rows. Minor: 淘汰落后产品. Targets: domestic market satisfaction rate stable at ~70%.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进二代改进型、AP1000核电设备自主化
quote_en: Push the localisation of improved Gen-II and AP1000 nuclear equipment.
notes: Among the 十大领域 key projects.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进风电设备自主化，重点实现变频控制系统、风电轴承、碳纤维叶片等产品的国内制造
quote_en: Push localisation of wind equipment, focusing on converters, bearings and carbon-fibre blades.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 进一步提高70万千瓦以上水电设备、大型抽水蓄能机组
quote_en: Further raise capability in hydro units above 700 MW and large pumped-storage units.
notes: Sentence continues with 百万千瓦级超临界/超超临界火电设备; next sentence 发展大型火电、核电站辅机.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 开发太阳能发电设备
quote_en: Develop solar power-generation equipment.
notes: Single short clause inside the power-equipment task.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进750千伏、1000千伏交流和±800千伏直流输变电设备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of 750 kV, 1000 kV AC and +/-800 kV DC transmission equipment.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力发展新型采掘、提升、洗选设备
quote_en: Vigorously develop new mining, hoisting and washing equipment.
notes: Focus: electric-traction shearers, hydraulic supports.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 发展长距离输送管道燃压机组、大型管线球阀和控制系统等装备
quote_en: Develop long-distance pipeline gas-compressor sets, large ball valves and control systems.
notes: Also 发展大型液化天然气运输船及接收站等设备 (LNG carriers and terminals).

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 实现高速动车组、大功率交流传动电力/内燃机车、重载货车、大型养护机械等装备的国内制造
quote_en: Achieve domestic manufacture of high-speed EMUs, high-power AC-drive locomotives, heavy-haul wagons and large maintenance machinery.
notes: Next bullet: urban rail vehicles, signalling, train-network control (重点实施…自主化).

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 农机及农产品加工设备
concept_en: agricultural machinery and farm-product processing equipment
quote_zh: 大力发展大功率拖拉机及配套农机具、节能环保中型拖拉机等耕作机械
quote_en: Vigorously develop high-power tractors, implements and energy-saving medium tractors.
notes: Next bullet: 重点发展农产品精深加工成套设备、灌溉和排涝设备; subsidy for farm-machinery purchases.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 发展大型、新型施工机械
quote_en: Develop large, new-type construction machinery.
notes: Focus: tunnel boring machines, large crawler and all-terrain cranes, bridge-erecting machines.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 机场专用装备与港口机械
concept_en: airport special equipment and port machinery
quote_zh: 发展机场专用装备
quote_en: Develop airport special-purpose equipment.
notes: Adjacent bullet: 发展港口机械 (bucket-wheel stackers, car dumpers, ship unloaders).

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 大力发展污水污泥处理设备、脱硝脱硫设备、余热余气循环再利用设备
quote_en: Vigorously develop sewage/sludge treatment, denitrification and desulphurisation, and waste-heat/gas recycling equipment.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 高档数控机床与基础制造装备
concept_en: high-end CNC machine tools and basic manufacturing equipment
quote_zh: 加快实施高档数控机床与基础制造装备科技重大专项
quote_en: Speed up the S&T major project on high-end CNC machine tools and basic manufacturing equipment.
notes: Named national programme.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进大型冶金成套设备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of large metallurgical plant equipment.
notes: One of nine industry-linked equipment bullets (钢铁产业).

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点提高汽车冲压、装焊、涂装、总装四大工艺装备水平
quote_en: Focus on raising stamping, welding, painting and final-assembly process equipment.
notes: Equipment concept, not carmakers.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进石化装备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of petrochemical equipment.
notes: Covers 千万吨级炼油, 百万吨级乙烯, PTA, large fertiliser plants.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 实现船用柴油机、曲轴、推进器、舱室设备、甲板机械等关键零部件制造所需装备的自主化
quote_en: Localise the equipment needed to make marine diesel engines, crankshafts, propellers, cabin and deck machinery.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进轻工机械自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of light-industry machinery.
notes: Food machinery, pulp and paper machinery, plastics-forming machinery.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进纺织机械自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of textile machinery.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进有色冶金设备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of nonferrous metallurgical equipment.
notes: High-precision rolling mills, large-section extruders.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进电子信息装备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of electronic-information equipment.
notes: Key IC equipment and flat-panel production equipment named in the bullet.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 推进国防军工装备自主化
quote_en: Push localisation of defence-industry equipment.
notes: Aerospace, shipbuilding, ordnance, nuclear-industry equipment; L1-wide.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点发展大型核电设备铸锻件
quote_en: Focus on large nuclear-equipment castings and forgings.
notes: One of 四大配套产品. L2 none: castings/forgings do not map clearly to one SW L2.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点发展大功率电力电子元件、功能模块，大型、精密轴承
quote_en: Focus on high-power power-electronics components, function modules and large precision bearings.
notes: Also high-precision gear drives.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 重点发展大型精密型腔模具、精密冲压模具、高档模具标准件
quote_en: Focus on large precision cavity moulds, precision stamping dies and high-grade standard die parts.
notes: L2 none: dies and moulds do not map clearly to one SW L2.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
concept_zh: 特种原材料（电站用钢、取向硅钢）
concept_en: special raw materials (power-plant steel, grain-oriented silicon steel)
quote_zh: 重点发展耐高温、耐高压、耐腐蚀电站用钢（钢管）
quote_en: Focus on heat-, pressure- and corrosion-resistant steel (pipe) for power plants.
notes: Also high-permeability grain-oriented silicon steel for large transformers.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 2009年先行开展对高效电机推广应用的补贴
quote_en: In 2009 start with subsidies for the promotion and use of high-efficiency motors.
notes: Part of the energy-saving-product subsidy item.

doc_name: 装备制造业调整和振兴规划
quote_zh: 在工程承包、系统集成、设备租赁、提供解决方案、再制造等方面开展增值服务
quote_en: [Support leading equipment makers] to offer value-added services in contracting, system integration, leasing, solutions and remanufacturing.
notes: Broad concept, no single SW industry. Target: manufacturing-services revenue above 20% of sales at large groups.
